title: Longing is led home in saintly company
subtitle: Raag Maajh
summary: The shabad opens in aching longing for the Beloved and admits it cannot find the way alone. It searches mind and body, turns toward saintly company, and keeps asking to be brought near.
whyItMatters: This speaks to the person who feels alone, spiritually lost, or emotionally closed in. Taken faithfully, it changes loneliness from sealed isolation into guided longing and gives yearning somewhere truthful to go.
takeaway: Longing ripens when saintly company shows the way.

lines.translation: The Lord is my mind, body and breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau har bin dhoojaa avar na jaanaa ||
lines.translation: I do not know any other than the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਸਜਣੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: koiee sajan sa(n)t milai vaddabhaagee mai har prabh piaaraa dhasai jeeau ||1||
lines.translation: If only I could have the good fortune to meet some friendly Saint; he might show me the Way to my Beloved Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਖੋਜੀ ਭਾਲਿ ਭਾਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau man tan khojee bhaal bhaalaiee ||
lines.translation: I have searched my mind and body, through and through.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiau piaaraa preetam milai meree maiee ||
lines.translation: How can I meet my Darling Beloved, O my mother?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਦਸਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat khoj dhasaiee vich sa(n)gat har prabh vasai jeeau ||2||
lines.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I ask about the Path to God. In that Congregation, the Lord God abides. ||2||
My Darling Beloved True Guru is my Protector.
I am a helpless child-please cherish me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: meraa maat pitaa gur satigur pooraa gur jal mil kamal vigasai jeeau ||3||
lines.translation: The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, is my Mother and Father. Obtaining the Water of the Guru, the lotus of my heart blossoms forth. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai bin gur dhekhe needh na aavai ||
lines.translation: Without seeing my Guru, sleep does not come.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨਿ ਵੇਦਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man tan vedhan gur birahu lagaavai ||
lines.translation: My mind and body are afflicted with the pain of separation from the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਸੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har har dhiaa karahu gur melahu jan naanak gur mil rahasai jeeau ||4||2||
lines.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, show mercy to me, that I may meet my Guru. Meeting the Guru, servant Nanak blossoms forth. ||4||2||

structure: The shabad starts with longing honest enough to admit it cannot find the Beloved alone.
From there it searches inward and asks how true meeting can happen at all.
The closing movement rests by leaning toward saintly company as the place where yearning is guided home.
